android.desc:
Stay on track, without the noise.
Rou is a simple and calming routine manager built for people who struggle with traditional habit trackers. Instead of streaks and guilt, Rou gives you reusable checklists - called routines - that you can launch whenever you need them.

Whether it’s a morning routine, a work shutdown checklist, or a quick focus ritual, Rou helps you stay grounded and get things done - your way, on your time.

🌀 Why Rou?
No pressure: Start routines when you want, no daily nags.

Distraction-free: Minimal, clean interface designed to help you focus.

For real brains: Especially helpful if you don’t vibe with streak-based apps.

Reusable workflows: Save your routines and use them again and again.

Google Sign-In: Your checklists stay safe and synced.

Whether you're trying to add structure to your day or just need a way to get unstuck, Rou is here to support you - gently.

quotes.text:
I made a tool for myself. Sharing in case it's helpful for you too. It's totally free (beta) for now.

The idea came from one too many gym trips without my towel or sport shoes.

Only Android for now. IOS version coming soon.

I hope it scratches an itch.
